question: Tsering Landol, who was one of the recipients of the Padma Bhushan 2020 award, hails from:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh.**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Tsering Landol is an Indian gynecologist and one of the pioneers of women's health. 
 
• She hails from the Union Territory of Ladakh, India. 
 
• The Government of India awarded her the fourth highest civilian honor of the Padma Shri, in 2006, and Padma Bhusan in 2020 for her contributions to Indian medicine, making her one of the few woman recipients of the award from Jammu and Kashmir and the first Ladakhi woman doctor to receive the honor.
 
• She served at the Sonam Norboo Memorial Government Hospital, Leh, and is also associated with other educational institutions.
